records.jp: …と、いうことで。<CR>神様、きらら様、お願いします！
records.en_original: My turn! Oh, gods and Kirara, please grant my wish!
records.en_auxiliary: My turn! Oh, gods and Kirara, please grant my wish!
records.en: And so... God,<CR>Kirara-sama, please!

records.jp: ……どういうこと？
records.en_original: ...What are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What are you talking about?
records.en: ...What are you talking about?

records.jp: 狙ってるカプセルが、どうしても出ないんだよ～！
records.en_original: There's this capsule toy I want, but I can't win it no matter how hard I try!
records.en_auxiliary: There's this capsule toy I want, but I can't win it no matter how hard I try!
records.en: The capsule I'm after just will not come out!

records.jp: どれをまわせば出るとか、何回まわせば出るとか！<CR>そういうの、分かったりしない？
records.en_original: You don't happen to know which machine I should use or how many times I should try, do you?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't happen to know which machine I should use or how many times I should try, do you?
records.en: Which machine will give it to me, or how many times I need to spin...<CR>Can't you tell things like that?

records.jp: 子供の頃から一度たりとも、<CR>神様からカプセルトイについて、聞いたことはない
records.en_original: The Divine has never discussed capsule toys with me, unfortunately.
records.en_auxiliary: The Divine has never discussed capsule toys with me, unfortunately.
records.en: Not once since childhood has the Divine<CR>told Kirara anything about capsule toys.

records.jp: それに、今もまだ神様の声は聞こえないまま
records.en_original: And it's not like I can ask them now.
records.en_auxiliary: And it's not like I can ask them now.
records.en: And it's not like I can ask them now.

records.jp: ですよねー。<CR>やっぱり、無理かー……
records.en_original: Ah, right. No good, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, right. No good, huh...
records.en: Ah, right.<CR>No good, huh...

records.jp: 愛央は、どれを欲しがってる？
records.en_original: Which one did you want, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Which one did you want, Ao?
records.en: Which one did you want, Ao?

records.jp: この、柔らかミニチュアスイーツってやつ
records.en_original: They're called Squishy Small Sweets.
records.en_auxiliary: They're called Squishy Small Sweets.
records.en: This one called Soft Miniature Sweets.

records.jp: 柔らか……
records.en_original: Squishy...?
records.en_auxiliary: Squishy...?
records.en: Squishy...?

records.jp: それはもう、むっにむにのもっちもちで<CR>やばいよ
records.en_original: Yeah! They're super soft and squishy! Like little marshmallows.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! They're super soft and squishy! Like little marshmallows.
records.en: They're incredibly squishy and springy.<CR>It's amazing.

records.jp: むっにむにの……もっちもち……
records.en_original: Marshmallows...
records.en_auxiliary: Marshmallows...
records.en: Squishy... springy...

records.jp: この、神々の武器型ブローチってやつ
records.en_original: It's called Divine Blade Jewelry.
records.en_auxiliary: It's called Divine Blade Jewelry.
records.en: This one called the Gods' Weapon-Shaped Brooches.

records.jp: ……かっこいい
records.en_original: Cool...
records.en_auxiliary: Cool...
records.en: Cool...

records.jp: でしょ！　細かいところまで作り込まれてて<CR>ファンタジー好きとしてはたまらんのだよ！
records.en_original: Right?! They're super detailed! No fantasy-lover could say no to something like that!
records.en_auxiliary: Right?! They're super detailed! No fantasy-lover could say no to something like that!
records.en: Right? Every tiny detail is carefully made. As a fantasy fan,<CR>I cannot resist them!

records.jp: ちょっと、分かる……かも
records.en_original: I...think I understand what you mean.
records.en_auxiliary: I...think I understand what you mean.
records.en: I...think I understand what you mean.

records.jp: ま、試しに一回まわしてみよっかな。<CR>なんか今日は、出そうな気がするし！
records.en_original: I think I'll give it one spin. I have a good feeling about today!
records.en_auxiliary: I think I'll give it one spin. I have a good feeling about today!
records.en: I think I'll give it one spin.<CR>I have a good feeling about today!

records.jp: あー……これ、持ってるやつだあ。<CR>やっぱ、そう上手くいかないよねえ……
records.en_original: Gah. I've got this one already... Guess you can't win 'em all...
records.en_auxiliary: Gah. I've got this one already... Guess you can't win 'em all...
records.en: Gah. I've got this one already...<CR>Guess you can't win 'em all...

records.jp: ん？　どしたの？
records.en_original: Hm? What's up, Kirara?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? What's up, Kirara?
records.en: Hm? What's up, Kirara?

records.jp: あれ、あのカプセル。<CR>……きらら、ほしい
records.en_original: That capsule toy... I want that one.
records.en_auxiliary: That capsule toy... I want that one.
records.en: That one, that capsule...<CR>Kirara wants it.

records.jp: 「高く積み立てろトーテムポールブロック」……？
records.en_original: The "Stack 'Em Up Totem Block"?
records.en_auxiliary: The "Stack 'Em Up Totem Block"?
records.en: 'Stack It High! Totem Pole Blocks'...?

records.jp: これ、この、ぬぉーんってした顔のやつ。<CR>どうしよう、ときめきが止まらない
records.en_original: Yeah. The one with the face that's all scrunched up... It's so cute...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. The one with the face that's all scrunched up... It's so cute...
records.en: This one, with the face going 'nwooon.' What should<CR>Kirara do? Her heart will not stop fluttering.

records.jp: ぬぉーんって……
records.en_original: The one with the scrunched up face...?
records.en_auxiliary: The one with the scrunched up face...?
records.en: Going 'nwooon'...

records.jp: きららも、やってみたら？
records.en_original: Why don't you give it a try?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't you give it a try?
records.en: Why don't you give it a try?

records.jp: きらら、やったことない。もし、失敗したら<CR>取り返しのつかないことに……
records.en_original: I've never done something like this before. What if something were to go terribly wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: I've never done something like this before. What if something were to go terribly wrong?
records.en: Kirara has never tried.<CR>What if she fails and something irreversible happens...?

records.jp: ならない、ならない！<CR>お金を入れて回すだけだから！
records.en_original: Don't worry so much! All you do is stick in some money and turn it!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry so much! All you do is stick in some money and turn it!
records.en: Don't worry so much!<CR>All you do is stick in some money and turn it!

records.jp: ほら、やってみなよ
records.en_original: Give it a shot!
records.en_auxiliary: Give it a shot!
records.en: Give it a shot!

records.jp: きららの好みって、変わってるよね
records.en_original: You sure have some...interesting tastes.
records.en_auxiliary: You sure have some...interesting tastes.
records.en: You sure have some...interesting tastes.

records.jp: うん、知ってる
records.en_original: Yes, I know.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, I know.
records.en: Yes, I know.

records.jp: 気に入ったんなら、やってみれば？<CR>良いの出るかもしんないよ
records.en_original: Why don't you try and get it if you like it? You might get lucky!
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't you try and get it if you like it? You might get lucky!
records.en: Why don't you try and get it if you like it?<CR>You might get lucky!

records.jp: じゃあ、きららのすべてをかけてまわす
records.en_original: I'll bet everything on this one attempt...
records.en_auxiliary: I'll bet everything on this one attempt...
records.en: Then Kirara will stake everything on this spin.

records.jp: ……ぬぉーん、出た
records.en_original: Oh, I got it.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I got it.
records.en: ...The 'nwooon' one came out.

records.jp: ちょっ！？　一回目で！？<CR>やば、すごすぎ……神様のお告げがあったとか？
records.en_original: Wha—?! On your first go?! I can't believe it... Is this the power of the Divine?
records.en_auxiliary: Wha—?! On your first go?! I can't believe it... Is this the power of the Divine?
records.en: What!? On the first try!?<CR>That's incredible... Did you receive an oracle from the Divine?

records.jp: いや、なにもぽわわんってこなかった。<CR>ただ、回したら出てきた
records.en_original: No, I didn't feel anything... I just turned the handle and it appeared.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I didn't feel anything... I just turned the handle and it appeared.
records.en: No. Nothing went 'powaan' inside Kirara.<CR>She only spun it, and it came out.

records.jp: ……もしかして、きらら。<CR>カプセルトイの天才？
records.en_original: Then... I must be a capsule toy genius!
records.en_auxiliary: Then... I must be a capsule toy genius!
records.en: ...Could Kirara<CR>be a capsule-toy genius?

records.jp: 天才！　天才！<CR>私なんて、何度回したことか……
records.en_original: I've failed to get what I wanted countless times. I bow before your great power, capsule queen...
records.en_auxiliary: I've failed to get what I wanted countless times. I bow before your great power, capsule queen...
records.en: A genius! A genius!<CR>And I've spun it so many times...

records.jp: ん～……じゃあ、愛央にきららの念送る。<CR>もしかしたら、それで出るかも
records.en_original: Hmm... I suppose I could bless you with some of my luck. Maybe it will help you get yours.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I suppose I could bless you with some of my luck. Maybe it will help you get yours.
records.en: Hmm... Then Kirara will send some of her energy to Ao.<CR>Maybe it will come out that way.

records.jp: おお、いいね！　運気のおすそ分け！
records.en_original: Really?! You'll share with me?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?! You'll share with me?
records.en: Oh, nice! Share some of your luck with me!

records.jp: 手、出して
records.en_original: Hold out your hand.
records.en_auxiliary: Hold out your hand.
records.en: Hold out your hand.

records.jp: はい！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: みょんみょんみょんみょん……
records.en_original: Byew-yew-yew...
records.en_auxiliary: Byew-yew-yew...
records.en: Miyon miyon miyon miyon...

records.jp: ……どう？
records.en_original: How do you feel?
records.en_auxiliary: How do you feel?
records.en: How do you feel?

records.jp: もう少し欲しいな
records.en_original: I think I need a little bit more.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I need a little bit more.
records.en: I think I need a little bit more.

records.jp: わかった。<CR>みょんみょんみょん……
records.en_original: Sure. Byew-yew-yew...
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. Byew-yew-yew...
records.en: All right.<CR>Miyon miyon miyon...

records.jp: ……うん、届いた気がする！<CR>よーし、やったるぞー！！
records.en_original: I think that's it! All right, here we go!
records.en_auxiliary: I think that's it! All right, here we go!
records.en: ...Yeah, I think it reached me!<CR>All right, I'm doing this!

records.jp: ばっちり！
records.en_original: Perfect!
records.en_auxiliary: Perfect!
records.en: Perfect!

records.jp: それじゃ、回してみるのだ
records.en_original: Here we go.
records.en_auxiliary: Here we go.
records.en: Then give it a spin.

records.jp: はい、いってまいります！
records.en_original: Come on!
records.en_auxiliary: Come on!
records.en: Yes, here I go!

records.jp: ……愛央、ごめん。<CR>きららが、カプセルトイの天才なだけだった
records.en_original: Sorry, Ao... It seems my capsule powers only work for me...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, Ao... It seems my capsule powers only work for me...
records.en: ...Sorry, Ao.<CR>It turns out Kirara was simply a capsule-toy genius.
